# MongoDB Playground

> An online MongoDB playground for builders, human and agent. Run mongosh-style statements (CRUD, aggregation,
> indexes, Atlas Search, Vector Search) against documents you supply, read query plans, and share a UUID link.
> Rust API + Svelte UI + Tauri desktop app. Apache-2.0. Agents are first-class users.

## Use it
- [Agent guide](AGENTS.md): API, MCP tools, limits, suggested flow
- [Live API reference](crates/api/src/llms.txt): the quick start the running service serves at /llms.txt
- [OpenAPI 3.1](crates/api/src/openapi.json): REST API under /api/v1
- [Run it yourself](docs/run-it-yourself.md): local Atlas CLI deployment, free M0 cluster, ephemeral cluster, Docker Compose

## Markdown for agents
- Every page of the live site is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path
  (`/index.md`, `/docs/quickstart.md`, `/docs/api.md`, `/docs/mcp.md`, `/docs/run-it-yourself.md`, `/about.md`).
  The text lives in [crates/api/src/pages](crates/api/src/pages).
